#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

static bool isSeparator(char c) {
    return c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')';
}

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string str;
    cin >> str;
    const char* arr = str.c_str();

    int maxSize = 0;
    int currentSize = 0;
    int wordCount = 0;
    int wordFlag = 0;
    bool inside = false;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char c = arr[i];

        if (c == '(') {
            inside = true;
            if (currentSize != 0) {
                maxSize = max(maxSize, currentSize);
                currentSize = 0;
            }
            wordFlag = 0;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            inside = false;
            if (currentSize != 0) {
                maxSize = max(maxSize, currentSize);
                currentSize = 0;
            }
        }

        if (inside) {
            if (wordFlag != 1 && !isSeparator(c)) {
                wordCount++;
                wordFlag = 1;
            }
            if (isSeparator(c)) {
                wordFlag = 0;
            }
        } else {
            if (!isSeparator(c)) {
                currentSize++;
                if (i == n - 1) {
                    maxSize = max(maxSize, currentSize);
                }
            } else {
                if (currentSize != 0) {
                    maxSize = max(maxSize, currentSize);
                    currentSize = 0;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    cout << maxSize << " " << wordCount << endl;
    return 0;
}
